subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should `onProgressNarratorLifecycle`, `isProgressDraftVisible`, and `progressPreambleEnabled` become the supported public Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned progress presentation?
rationale: The implementation is additive and tested, but repository policy treats new Plugin SDK calls as a durable compatibility decision that cannot be settled by CI or patch correctness alone.

options.title: Accept the typed SDK seam
options.body: Adopt the three optional fields as the canonical channel-owned lifecycle contract and land after rebasing and refreshing focused checks.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Refactor the lifecycle plumbing behind an internal or narrower existing channel runtime seam before merging, avoiding new public Plugin SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the typed SDK seam
recommendation.body: Adopt the three optional fields as the canonical channel-owned lifecycle contract and land after rebasing and refreshing focused checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and discussion place this person closest to both the progress-draft architecture and proposed SDK boundary.
